messages:
maria: quick sync — customer asked for end-to-end audit evidence for login + token exchange flows. Current ask: schema with immutable event ids + proof of delivery. we have some gaps across api-gw, auth, console, billing, runtime. can we triage?
aj: thanks. can we get a short inventory first: which services currently emit signed audit events vs simple logs?
samir: quick list from my side: api-gw emits basic access logs (no event_id), auth emits `user.auth` events but missing `actor_id` in some flows, console emits UI actions but they go through analytics pipeline not audit, billing emits high-level invoices but not per-API call, runtime (model-serving) has KV cache ops but no structured audit schema.
maria: that matches my notes. key asks from compliance: 1) canonical schema change (event_id, timestamp, actor, target, action, outcome, ctx) 2) cryptographic proof option (sig/kms) 3) customer-facing event validation tool so enterprise customers can verify events.
kevin: for schema, I'd propose minimal v2 shape: ```json
{
  "event_id": "uuidv4",
  "ts": "iso8601",
  "actor": {"id": "user:123", "type": "user|svc"},
  "target": {"id": "resource:abc", "type": "model|token|invoice"},
  "action": "string",
  "outcome": "success|failure",
  "meta": {"ip": "", "user_agent": ""},
  "signature": {"alg": "RS256|HS256|kms", "sig": "base64..."}
}
```
kevin: optional `signature` field for signed/audit-proof events. keep raw log fallback for internal only.
nora: I can own a KMS signing POC for v2 events. plan: hook auth service to signing plugin, rotate keys via KMS, provide a verification endpoint for customers (public key publish + signature header). aiming for POC in 2 wks. assigned to @nora. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — we also need to decide which services adopt signature by default vs opt-in. my suggestion: auth + billing + api-gw = default, console + runtime = opt-in for now. thoughts?
aj: agree with defaults. runtime is tricky because of high qps and small events — signing could add latency. consider batching signatures or HMAC with ephemeral keys.
samir: runtime suggestion: emit unsigned event to internal audit queue, create periodic signed manifests (e.g., hourly merkle root) so customers can validate bulk integrity without per-event sign overhead.
kevin: good pattern. we'll need schema for manifest: `{"interval_start":"ts","interval_end":"ts","root":"hex","signature":"..."}`.
maria: backlog triage — let's create tickets and owners. immediate priorities (this week): inventory per service, schema PR, KMS POC, customer validator prototype. secondary (next sprint): rollout plan, perf testing, docs + console UI for verifying.
audit-bot: New ticket created: INFSEC-1427 "audit-schema-v2-proposal" assigned to kevin. (link: https://rwd-jira.internal/browse/INFSEC-1427)
kevin: tagging in perf team for runtime impact: @samir can you draft a perf hypothesis and measurements we should run? sample:  p99 latency delta with per-event HMAC vs unsigned.
samir: will do — plan: baseline qps replay + sign plugin on staging with KMS stub. estimate 3 days to benchmark.
nora: question on RBAC: will verifying events require exposing a public key per customer or shared? compliance prefers per-customer key to prove non-repudiation. complexity: key management + rotation + multi-tenant KMS usage.
maria: ok mark as decision point. short-term: per-customer pubkeys for enterprise only. long-term: offer hosted key rotation + HSM. add to ticket.
aj: customer-facing validator: small CLI `rwd-verify-audit --event-file e.json --pubkey pk.pem` and a lightweight web tool. kevin, can you own validator prototype?
kevin: yes. will open INFSEC-1429 for validator prototype.
maria: action items recap: 1) samir — service inventory + perf plan (due EOD Thu) 2) kevin — schema PR + validator prototyping (schema PR by Tue) 3) nora — KMS POC (2wks) 4) aj — coordinate with product for customer requirements & docs (sync Fri). i'll consolidate into a short runbook afterwards.
kevin: small example CLI snippet to verify signature (for the validator): ```bash
# verify RS256 signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature event.sig event.json
```
maria: meeting tomorrow 11am to sign off on schema, invite: eng-sre, runtime, product, compliance. please bring perf numbers if you have them.
audit-bot: Reminder: calendar event created "Audit schema v2 signoff" Thu 11:00.
kevin: any objections to making `event_id` immutable and indexed in audit DB for fast lookup? search will be customer-critical.
aj: no objections. big win for e-discovery. add index cost to infra estimate.
samir: note — API-GW currently strips some headers, ensure `x-audit-event-id` is preserved end-to-end. I'll open a small change in gateway to passthrough.
maria: thanks. marking owners in backlog. we'll reconvene after the POC results. if anyone sees a blocker, drop a note here.
kevin: adding doc links: design doc draft https://rwd-docs.internal/audit-schema-v2 (please review).
nora: FYI: KMS team asked about required entropy for signing keys for per-customer HSM. I'll loop them in.
maria: perfect. closing for now — appreciate the quick triage :rocket:
